STATUS: revise

OBSERVED — `runReview` turns a valid stage-3 `decision-required` result into ordinary `blocked` state (`relay-target.ts:1745`). A later explicit `--slice` resume unconditionally changes every blocked slice to `implement`, increments its iteration, and converts `evidence-bound` tracking to `building` (`:3101-3128`). It will therefore dispatch another builder without a recorded decision resolution.

This contradicts the accepted slice §8.2: a `decision-required` result “does not … invoke another builder,” and defeats AM-REQ-005-L05’s no-blocking-decisions completion predicate.

Required correction:

1. Preserve refusal on plain resume for a stage-3 structured decision result; it must remain visibly blocked until an authorized resolution path exists. Do not add ASSURANCE-4 recovery/acceptance machinery.
2. Add a relay test proving a decision-required implementation review followed by plain `--slice` resume makes zero builder calls and retains the decision matrix/block.

OBSERVED — Scope is otherwise confined to the seven authorized paths; `git diff --check` and `npm run typecheck` passed.  
INFERRED — The builder’s reported Jest/build results were not independently rerun because this review environment is read-only and the suite creates disposable fixtures.
